title: ohneis652 — foldable fashion shop: a phone as a tiny laptop runway
note: A foldable phone stood up like a tiny laptop is two screens: top half a runway with 10 looks to swipe, bottom half tappable cards per piece; the back view is generated from the front picture, and the turn is one single Seedance shot. Workflow: Figma layout, GPT Image 2.6 for front and back views, Seedance 2.5 for the turn video, Claude codes the working site. Why she saved it: the scroll-scrubs-a-single-video technique fits her Play work, and the front-to-back generation fits the clothing-brand goal. Her second ohneis652 save; the first was the foldable shop, the other is the Side A record-store site.
